verses.text: For the music director. Of the sons of Korah. A thoughtful psalm. God, we have heard it with our own ears. Our ancestors told us what you did in their days, long ago.
With your own hand you drove out the nations and planted our ancestors in the land. You crushed the peoples and made our ancestors spread out.
They did not take the land with their own swords. Their own strength did not save them. It was your right hand, your strength, and the light of your face, because you loved them.
God, you are my King. Command victories for the people of Jacob!
With your help we push back our enemies. With the power of your name we trample those who attack us.
I do not trust in my bow. My sword cannot save me.
But you save us from our enemies. You put those who hate us to shame.
We boast about God all day long. We will praise your name forever. Selah.
But now you have rejected us and disgraced us. You no longer go out with our armies.
You made us run away from our enemies. Those who hate us have robbed us.
You have let us be eaten like sheep, and you have scattered us among the nations.
You sold your people for almost nothing. You gained nothing from selling them.
You have made us a joke to our neighbours. The people around us laugh at us and make fun of us.
You have made us an insult among the nations. People shake their heads at us.
I live in disgrace all day long. My face is covered with shame
because of the insults of those who mock me, because of the enemy who wants revenge.
All this has happened to us, but we have not forgotten you. We have not been unfaithful to your covenant.
Our hearts have not turned away. Our feet have not left your path.
But you crushed us and left us where the jackals live. You covered us with deep darkness.
If we had forgotten the name of our God or lifted our hands in prayer to a foreign god,
wouldn't God have found out? He knows the secrets of every heart.
But because of you we face death all day long. We are thought of as sheep to be killed.
Wake up, Lord! Why are you sleeping? Get up! Do not reject us forever.
Why do you hide your face? Why do you forget our suffering and how we are being crushed?
We are pushed down into the dust. Our bodies cling to the ground.
Get up and help us. Rescue us because of your faithful love.
